scope: Curated GH1 candidates, not a complete or official inventory. Third-party category listings are dated 2022–2023; names and metadata need SDK confirmation. Null = unknown; never infer defaults or GUIDs. Status reflects baseline NODES code, not a comparison run. OMEGA 67: targeted source audit; not full revalidation.

gh2.note: Official index lists components and parameters; count is not a count of individually audited standard nodes. Names selected from index; individual pages used only where GUID is known. No GH1 GUIDs or results reused. No oracle results.

gh1.note: Counts are mixed 2022–2023 third-party index snapshots, not current official GH1 totals. Rhino category and other newer categories are not fully enumerated.

status_definitions.VERIFIED: Mapped implementation compared with archived reference results from a named GH build; registration or NODES-only tests are insufficient.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Mapped implementation exists; GH reference equivalence has not been established.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Only part of the component contract is implemented.
status_definitions.APPROXIMATE: Mapped implementation uses an explicitly approximate representation or algorithm.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Required underlying type or kernel is unavailable on the audited baseline.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Public specification or implementation evidence is insufficient.
